title: A call from home
plot: Alex's mom calls from Canada; he tells her about friends and work.
paragraphs: Tonight I got a phone call.

paragraphs.note: 母 (はは) is how you speak of your own mother to others. Talking to her, or about someone else's mother, it's お母さん (おかあさん). Family words often come in pairs like this.

paragraphs: アレックス|「好き！ラーメンがうまい！」
"I love it! The ramen is great!"
アレックス|「ユキ、ケンタ、ミホさん。いい友達だよ。」
アレックス|「バイトも好き。店長は、いい人だよ。」
"I like the job too. The manager's a good guy."
アレックス|「桜の写真も、撮ったよ！」
"I took pictures of the cherry blossoms, too!"
